offering_description.value: Contract research, development and manufacturing of cosmetic formulations for client companies that own the brands. Main production is at a factory in Totowa, New Jersey, supported by R&D work with a Korean partner lab.

quotes.quote: company that specializes in cosmetics R&D and manufacturing, providing best-quality products and services

The Totowa factory is Englewood Lab's main production base. Our production capabilities continue to grow in response to increasing client demand for our extensive expertise. On the strength of our quality focused manufacturing and our synergistic relationship with Cosmecca Korea, Englewood Lab is ready to meet your manufacturing needs for a wide variety of cosmetic formulations in every product category.

quotes.quote: We love a challenge. Our excellent R&D capabilities and dedication to highquality service make us a company that will grow with our clients, accepting challenges no one has ever faced and turning them into opportunities for innovation and growth.

Beauty is more than skin deep, and we believe there is beauty in robust research methods and consistent manufacturing processes. Beautiful work is work done well. We know attention to detail at every step is critical to producing safe products and to producing them consistently and efficiently. Our rigorous testing and quality assurance practices ensure that our products are completely identical at any scale or batch size. Full regulatory compliance around the world is proof that we take protecting our customers’ reputations – and the consumer’s safety – very seriously.
